steps.statement: An application adapter declares an identifiable build and endpoint, owned setup and teardown, fresh test state, controller and fixture inputs, and explicit host trust assumptions.
An affected user-facing scenario runs against the current repository and served application state.

The host agent inspects actual browser and runtime observations, and acceptance identifies scenario, source/build/endpoint/controller state, collection method, freshness, outcome, cleanup and assurance.

Wrong-build or wrong-endpoint observations, contaminated prior state, missing or unavailable collection, failed setup, interrupted cleanup, or a stored promise are reported as successful behavioral proof; browser evidence is used to claim unobserved acoustic, device, or learning outcomes.

payload.title: Inspect application behavior in an owned test instance
